performance.verdict: ROAS collapse is real; top campaign scaling into saturation, not noise.

findings.text: ROAS dropped 63.53% WoW while spend rose 13.96%; last 3 days (Sep 9–11) show purchases of 0, 1, 2 on spend of $40.60, $57.44, $52.27 — well below the Aug 29 single-day $1,727.93 revenue spike that inflated the prior week baseline.

5 overdue milestones (Aug 14–31): Live-Cooking Shoot 1, Pre-Launch Gate, Platform Ownership, Funnel Test + UTM Live, SEO Phase 1 — all unresolved as of Sep 12, blocking attribution clarity and go-live.
GBP actions collapsed: 0 recorded on Sep 9, 10, 11 after averaging ~28/day in August — a 3-day confirmed dark signal, not a one-day anomaly.
IG reach declining: 3-day avg (Sep 9–11) = 622 vs prior-3-day avg (Sep 6–8) = 674, and down from Aug peak of 1,105 on Aug 25 — consistent with creative fatigue as spend holds flat.

GA4 sessions holding (280–285 last 2 days) while purchases are 1–2/day; the Aug 29 outlier ($1,727.93 revenue, 3 purchases) likely reflects a large single order distorting 7d ROAS comparison — not a structural improvement.

suggestions.text: Pause or cap 'BWS - Sales - Muslims' at $839.72/28d spend; 3-day purchases (0,1,2) confirm diminishing returns at current budget.
suggestions.monday_update: The top campaign 'BWS - Sales - Muslims' has absorbed $839.72 over 28 days and produced 0, 1, and 2 purchases across the last 3 days (Sep 9–11) while spend held at ~$50/day. ROAS is down 63.53% WoW on a 13.96% spend increase, and IG reach has declined from a peak of 1,105 to a 3-day avg of 622, signalling creative fatigue compounding the saturation. Reduce daily budget by 30% or pause the ad set and redirect budget to a fresh creative batch. Success check: purchases return to 3+/day average within 7 days (by Sep 19).

suggestions.text: Investigate GBP tracking: 0 actions recorded Sep 9–11 after 28/day August average — confirm data feed, not profile suspension.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions hit zero for three consecutive days (Sep 9, 10, 11) after averaging approximately 28 actions/day through August. This is a confirmed 3-day dark signal. Check the GBP data connector and the profile status in Google Business dashboard to rule out suspension or feed break before attributing the drop to organic decline. Success check: GBP actions resume reporting with non-zero values by Sep 15.

suggestions.text: Watch Funnel Test + UTM milestone: zero purchases from /halal-subscribe remain unresolved; re-check Sep 15 after milestone escalation.
suggestions.monday_update: The Funnel Test Closed + UTM Live milestone was due Aug 31 and remains overdue. The /halal-subscribe page showed zero add-to-carts in the test phase, and without UTM live, Meta purchase attribution via Shopify continues to undercount. No buyer action is taken this cycle on this item. Re-check Sep 15: if UTM is not live by then, escalate to Nacer as a go-live blocker impacting ROAS accuracy.
